methodology.comparison_scope: This result is only for the included deterministic corpus; it is not a competitor benchmark.

corpus_manifest.methodology: Canonical corpus metadata is derived directly from benchmark case declarations; the manifest is not a substitute for independent truth review.

canonical_corpus.denominator: one explicit case is one applicable assurance obligation; ambiguous cases remain visible and are excluded from precision/recall.

relationship_graph.statement: Relationships are benchmark metadata and do not by themselves prove application authorization behavior.
